kilobot.description: Kilobot is the first Roblosats coordinator: peer-to-peer trades of Bitcoin on the BLAKE2b chain over its Lightning network, with no KYC. Run by Kilombino on his own node, which already has plenty of channels.
kilobot.motto: Sats on the BLAKE2b chain, robot to robot ⚡

policies.Privacy Policy: Kilobot does not collect, store or share personal information. It only keeps the minimum data needed to run active trades (order details, hold invoices) and to resolve disputes.
policies.Data Policy: No user data is shared with third parties. Dispute data is kept only while the dispute is open.
policies.Rule 1:: Do not share personal information in the chat unless it is strictly needed to complete the trade.
policies.Rule 2:: Users are responsible for complying with the laws of their own jurisdiction.
